    • customBorderSet

      public Block.Builder customBorderSet(BorderSet borderSet)
      Sets a custom border set with specific characters for each border element.

      When set, this overrides the characters from borderType(BorderType). Characters can be empty strings ("") to skip rendering that element.

      Example for corners-only rendering: 

      customBorderSet(new BorderSet("", "", "", "", "┌", "┐", "└", "┘"))
      Parameters:
      borderSet - the custom border set, or null to use borderType
      Returns:
      this builder

      public Block.Builder mergeBorders(MergeStrategy mergeStrategy)
      Sets the merge strategy for borders.
